com.esignal.jstandard.beans.flex

Enum FlexData.DATATYPE

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<FlexData.DATATYPE>
      • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.flex.FlexData.DATATYPE
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<FlexData.DATATYPE>
    Enclosing interface:
    FlexData

    public static enum FlexData.DATATYPE
extends java.lang.Enum<FlexData.DATATYPE>
    An Enumeration representing the supported Flex Data Types. This enumeration also maps the rawType from the schema to a java type.

    • Enum Constant Summary

      Enum Constants 
      Enum Constant and Description
      BOOLEAN
      1 byte, 1 indicates true, other values indicate false.
      BYTEARRAY
      An array of bytes.
      CHAR
      1 byte signed value ranging from (-2^7)+1 to (2^7)-1 (i.e. -127 to 127) inclusive, with -2^7 (i.e. -128) reserved to represent null (i.e. not present).
      COMPOSITE
      Composite type means that a FlexDataField is composed of one or more FlexDataFields.
      DATE
      4 byte unsigned value representing the YYYYMMDD as an Integer (e.g. the date 20170523 equals 0x0133C71B), with 4 bytes of 0xFF (i.e. 0xFFFFFFFF) reserved to represent null (i.e. not present).
      DATETIME
      8 byte unsigned value representing a local date/time (local to the source) in the format of YYYYMMDDHHMMSSmmm as a Long (e.g. the date and time 20170523113401500 equals 0x0047A8FBE11BAC9C), with 8 bytes of 0xFF (i.e. 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFL) reserved to represent null (i.e. not present).
      DOUBLE
      8 byte double-precision 64-bit IEEE 754 floating point value, with 8 bytes of 0xFF (i.e. 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFL) reserved to represent null (i.e. not present).

      1 byte signed value ranging from (-2^7)+1 to (2^7)-1 (i.e. -127 to 127) inclusive, with -2^7 (i.e. -128) reserved to represent null (i.e. not present).
      STRING
      A string of characters.

    • Enum Constant Detail

      • CHAR

        public static final FlexData.DATATYPE CHAR
        1 byte signed value ranging from (-2^7)+1 to (2^7)-1 (i.e. -127 to 127) inclusive, with -2^7 (i.e. -128) reserved to represent null (i.e. not present).

        Use FlexDataField.isNull() to check if the value is null, if not null, use FlexDataField#getValueAsByte() to get the value for this data type. Note that calling a FlexDataField#getValueAs* method (e.g. getValueAsShort, getValueAsInteger, getValueAsLong, getValueAsBigInteger), the null value will be up-casted to the smallest value supported for that type.

        public static final FlexData.DATATYPE BOOLEAN

      • BYTEARRAY

        public static final FlexData.DATATYPE BYTEARRAY
        An array of bytes. Null (i.e. not present) is specified as all bytes in the array are 0xFF.

        Use FlexDataField.isNull() to check if the value is null, if not null, use FlexDataField#getValueAsByteArray() to get the value of this field type.

      • STRING

        public static final FlexData.DATATYPE STRING
        A string of characters. Null (i.e. not present) is specified as 0xFF followed by 0x00.

        Use FlexDataField.isNull() to check if the value is null, if not null, use FlexDataField#getValueAsString(Charset) to get the value of this field type.

      • UNKNOWN

        public static final FlexData.DATATYPE UNKNOWN

The user of this API can use the FlexDataField.getRawType() method to get a String representation of the raw type, and FlexDataField.getValueAsBytes() to get the value of the field in bytes.
